title: nan
authors: Mohta K.; Sun K.; Liu S.; Watterson M.; Pfrommer B.; Svacha J.; Mulgaonkar Y.; Taylor C.J.; Kumar V.
key_contribution: Presents system integration and algorithms enabling high-speed (over 18 m/s) autonomous quadrotor flight and navigation through mixed indoor/outdoor GPS-denied environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Radio_Based_Positioning to ensure precise positioning.
